runs.text: of the church in Cenchrea.

runs.originalText: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the saints with them.

runs.text: Avoid Divisions
Titus 3:9–11
Now I urge you, brothers, to watch out for those who create divisions and obstacles that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Turn away from them.
runs.originalText: Now I urge you, brothers, to watch out for those who create divisions and obstacles that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Turn away from them.

runs.text: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
runs.originalText: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.

runs.text: Everyone has heard about your obedience, so I rejoice over you. But I want you to be wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil.
runs.originalText: Everyone has heard about your obedience, so I rejoice over you. But I want you to be wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil.

runs.text: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ
runs.originalText: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ

runs.text: be with you.
runs.originalText: be with you.

runs.text: Greetings from Paul’s Fellow Workers
Colossians 4:7–14
Timothy, my fellow worker, sends you greetings, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my fellow countrymen.
runs.originalText: Timothy, my fellow worker, sends you greetings, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my fellow countrymen.

runs.text: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.
runs.originalText: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.

runs.text: Gaius, who has hosted me and all the church, sends you greetings.
runs.originalText: Gaius, who has hosted me and all the church, sends you greetings.

runs.text: Erastus, the city treasurer, sends you greetings, as does our brother Quartus.
runs.originalText: Erastus, the city treasurer, sends you greetings, as does our brother Quartus.

runs.text: Doxology
Now to Him who is able to strengthen you by my gospel and by the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery concealed for ages past

runs.text: but now revealed and made known through the writings of the prophets by the command of the eternal God, in order to lead all nations to the obedience that comes from faith
runs.originalText: but now revealed and made known through the writings of the prophets by the command of the eternal God, in order to lead all nations to the obedience that comes from faith
